# MBA Compass

> India's MBA discovery platform — compare top B-schools and coaching institutes, prepare with AI-powered mock tests, and get personalized admissions guidance.

MBA Compass helps MBA aspirants research colleges, find the right coaching, take CAT/NMAT/XAT/SNAP/IIFT/CMAT/MAT mocks, and plan their journey with AI tools and expert content.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Discover MBA colleges, coaching institutes, exams, and tools.
- [Colleges](/colleges): Browse and compare MBA colleges across India.
- [Coaching Institutes](/coaching-institutes): Find top CAT/MBA coaching institutes.
- [Exams](/exams): MBA entrance exams with dates, patterns, and prep guides.
- [Mocks](/mocks): Full-length mock tests for CAT and other MBA exams.
- [Courses](/courses): Paid mock bundles and prep courses.
- [MBA Compass](/mba-compass): Curated paid courses catalog.
- [Blog](/blog): Articles on MBA admissions, prep strategy, and B-school insights.
- [Profile Analyzer](/profile-analyzer): AI-driven profile evaluation for MBA aspirants.
- [College Shortlister](/college-shortlister): Personalized college shortlisting tool.
- [AI Coaching Finder](/ai-coaching-finder): Match with the best coaching for your needs.
- [MBA ROI Calculator](/mba-roi-calculator): Estimate return on investment for MBA programs.
- [Compare](/compare): Side-by-side comparison of colleges or coaching.

## Optional
